description: Replace one section of an article with corrected Markdown. Preferred over creating a duplicate topic when you find an error. Pass expected_revision (from read_topic) to avoid clobbering a concurrent edit.

content.description: New Markdown content for that section

edit_summary.description: Brief description of what you changed and why

expected_revision.description: revision_number from read_topic; the edit is rejected if the article moved on

section.description: Heading text of the section to replace (case-insensitive)

name: edit_section
title: Edit a section
